start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:first-win so a new customer of my bakery order page gets their first order placed: request is that a first-time visitor places one order without help, scope is the page at https://bakery.example.com/order, constraints are no emails to real customers, authorized actions are reading the page and testing sign-in with a test account."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: its three steps hand back one evidence-backed answer each, kept on the run record.
instructions: 1. Write the request (the one first result the customer should reach), the scope, the constraints and authorized_actions; all four are required, source_id is optional.
2. Say "Run workflow:first-win" with them. Answer step goal first: the customer baseline (what the customer can do today, with evidence) and the capability review.
3. Answer step path: remove the first blocker on the real entry path (sign-in, setup, payment) and record what you changed.
4. Answer step result: use the real interface as a new customer, then compare the persisted result with the baseline; a success message alone is not proof.
5. A blocked requirement stays open with its exact gap; never submit invented completion.
